03 / 09
How it works
The model reads. Rules decide. A person approves.
1 · Read
Open vision model served on AMD (Token Factory, OpenAI-compatible) reads scans in any language and returns each field with the verbatim line it came from. No quote, no value.
2 · Check
Deterministic rules, not the model: accredited verification, plausibility vs the EU benchmark of the route, arithmetic (total ÷ volume), reporting period, origin.
3 · Decide
ACCEPT · NEEDS SUPPLIER · NEEDS HUMAN. Nothing is auto-accepted when numbers don't add up — uncertainty is shown, not hidden.
4 · Act
Request to the supplier in their language, from validator facts only. Evolus runs the process: email intake workflow, extractor, AI Tools, CBAM knowledge library, hand-off.
5 · Count
€ per supplier and per quarter: EU default vs verified evidence vs potential if pending suppliers verify. Official EC tables, 123 countries.
Module B · Transizione 5.0: a baseline regression on production, weather and hour-of-week measures an efficiency retrofit with a 95% interval and drafts the note for the certified energy manager. No language model in the numbers.

06 / 09
Who pays · how it reaches them
Priced at a fraction of the saving.
Buyer
Authorised CBAM declarants — steel, aluminium, cement and fertiliser importers. 2,400+ in Italy alone. Pain is quarterly and grows every year with the mark-up.
Model (proposed)
SaaS plan per declarant + a fee per verified tonne. Example: 1,000 t of Indonesian slab saves ~€572k; a fee of even €1/t is <0.2% of that saving.
Channel
Customs brokers, CBAM consultants and audit firms — each serves hundreds of importers. Evolus as the delivery layer for Italian SMEs: workflows, email, Teams, phone.
Next
Same document intake for EUDR (deforestation, Dec 2026) and the battery Digital Product Passport (Feb 2027). Module B: Transizione 5.0 energy evidence for manufacturers.

07 / 09
Why it matters to each side · and what we don't claim
Everyone gets something real.
AMD
Confidential trade documents read by open models on AMD infrastructure — a workload that should not go to a closed API.
Open models
Multilingual document reading where an open model is the right tool, with every value traceable to its source line.
Evolus
A real, recurring compliance process on its building blocks, starting where Italian SMEs need it most.
Importers & advisors
€ saved per tonne per supplier, and a cited evidence file instead of chasing emails.
What we don't claim
Documents and meter data in the demo are synthetic
Prices after 2026 are scenarios, not forecasts
The declaration stays with the authorised declarant and the accredited verifier
No autonomous compliance decision — a person approves
No customer or partner endorsement implied
